description: This bar chart illustrates the effect sizes for various multilingual BERT models—specifically mBERT-L₂, XLM-L₂, mBERT-R₂, XLM-R₂, mBERT-B₂, and XLM-B₂—across three different probing tasks labeled 'case', 'gender', and 'number' along the horizontal axis, with the vertical axis representing the 'effect' measured on a linear scale from 0 to 20. The bars are grouped by task, and within each group, the six models are represented by distinct colors as indicated in the legend: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light red), and XLM-B₂ (dark red). For the 'case' task, the effect sizes are highest for mBERT-B₂ (approximately 12) and XLM-B₂ (approximately 11), followed by mBERT-L₂ and XLM-L₂ (both around 6), with mBERT-R₂ and XLM-R₂ showing smaller effects (around 2). In the 'gender' task, all models show smaller effects, with mBERT-B₂ and XLM-B₂ again being the highest (around 4), followed by mBERT-L₂ and XLM-L₂ (around 2), and mBERT-R₂ and XLM-R₂ (around 1). For the 'number' task, all models show very small effects, mostly clustered near zero, with mBERT-B₂ and XLM-B₂ showing slightly larger values (around 2), followed by mBERT-L₂ and XLM-L₂ (around 1), and mBERT-R₂ and XLM-R₂ (around 0.5). The bars are not sorted by height and are not visually emphasized beyond their standard representation; each bar is accompanied by error bars indicating variability.
